MEET DJ WATTS

Seasoned perspective.
Direct accountability.

When you contact Break Point Investigations, you can reach the person responsible for the work.

Delvin J. Watts, known as DJ, is the owner and operator of Break Point Investigations. His agency proposal identifies 24 years of law-enforcement experience, including a retired lieutenant role with the Contra Costa Sheriff's Office and police service with the Richmond Police Department.

That experience informs a practical approach to background investigations: understand the assignment, follow relevant information, and develop the context needed for a better decision.
